payload.core_mechanism_summary: Separates into independent even/odd subsequences, then for each block of unknowns bounded by known values, uses a closed-form count of sequences with no adjacent equals, combining via product.
payload.rationale: Solution tackles a combinatorial counting problem, naturally framed as DP over sequence; though it uses a direct formula, it falls under dp_counting_combinatorics. The split reduces to independent 1D constraints.
